### Symbols for groups and algebras

| Symbol | Meaning |
|---|---|
| $G$, $\mathfrak g$ | Lie group and its Lie algebra, with bracket $[X, Y] = XY - YX$ for matrices |
| $S_n$ | symmetric group: the $n!$ permutations of $\{1, \dots, n\}$ |
| $e$, $g^{-1}$, $\lvert G\rvert$ | identity element, inverse, order (number of elements) of a group |
| $H \leq G$, $H \trianglelefteq G$ | $H$ is a subgroup, a normal subgroup of $G$ |
| $\langle g_1, \dots, g_k\rangle$ | subgroup generated by $g_1, \dots, g_k$ |
| $(a_1\,a_2\,\dots\,a_k)$ | $k$-cycle $a_1 \mapsto a_2 \mapsto \dots \mapsto a_k \mapsto a_1$; products of permutations are read right to left |
| $A_n$, $D_n$, $Q_8$ | alternating group (even permutations), dihedral group of order $2n$, quaternion group $\{\pm\mathbf I, \pm i\sigma_a\}$ |
| $\mu_n$ | group of the $n$-th roots of unity |
| $GL(n, \mathbb R)$, $SL(n, \mathbb R)$, $O(1, 3)$ | invertible, determinant-one and Lorentz matrices |
| $Z(G)$, $C(g)$ | centre of $G$, centraliser of $g$ |
| $gH$, $Hg$, $G/H$, $[G : H]$ | left and right cosets of $H \leq G$, the set of left cosets (the quotient group when $H \trianglelefteq G$), the index |
| $\mathbb Z_n^\times$, $\varphi(n)$ | residues modulo $n$ coprime to $n$ under multiplication; their number (Euler's function) |
| $g \cdot x$, $G \cdot x$, $G_x$, $X/G$ | action of $g$ on $x$, orbit and stabiliser of $x$, set of orbits |
| $[g]$, $X^g$ | conjugacy class of $g$; fixed points of $g$ in $X$ |
| $\phi : G \to G'$, $\ker\phi$, $\operatorname{im}\phi$ | homomorphism of groups, its kernel $\{g : \phi(g) = e'\}$ and its image $\phi(G)$ |
| $G \cong G'$ | $G$ and $G'$ are isomorphic |
| $\operatorname{Aut}(G)$, $\operatorname{Inn}(G)$, $c_g$ | automorphisms and inner automorphisms of $G$; conjugation $c_g(h) = ghg^{-1}$ |
| $A \times B$ | direct product of groups, $(a, b)(a', b') = (aa', bb')$ |
| $\mathbf P(\sigma)$ | permutation matrix of $\sigma \in S_n$, $\mathbf P(\sigma)\mathbf e_i = \mathbf e_{\sigma(i)}$ |
| $\lambda \vdash n$, $\ell(\lambda)$, $m_i(\lambda)$, $p(n)$ | $\lambda$ is a partition of $n$; its number of parts; its number of parts equal to $i$; the number of partitions of $n$ |
| $\lambda'$, $h(i, j)$, $f_\lambda$ | conjugate partition (transposed Young diagram); hook length of the box $(i, j)$; number of standard Young tableaux of shape $\lambda$ |
| $z_\lambda$ | $\prod_ii^{m_i(\lambda)}m_i(\lambda)!$, the order of the centraliser of a permutation of cycle type $\lambda$ |
| $V^{\otimes k}$, $\tau_\sigma$ | $k$-fold tensor power; the permutation of its factors by $\sigma \in S_k$ |
| $\operatorname{Sym}^kV$, $\Lambda^kV$ | symmetric and antisymmetric tensors in $V^{\otimes k}$ |
| $\mathbf L(\mathbf U)$ | rotation matrix of $\mathbf U \in SU(2)$, $\mathbf U(\mathbf x \cdot \boldsymbol\sigma)\mathbf U^\dagger = (\mathbf L(\mathbf U)\mathbf x) \cdot \boldsymbol\sigma$ |
| $SO(n)$, $SU(n)$, $U(n)$, $O(n)$ | matrix groups |
| $\mathfrak{so}(1, 3)$, $\mathfrak{su}(n)$, $\mathfrak{sl}(2, \mathbb C)$ | their Lie algebras (Fraktur) |
| $S/R$ | coset space of a Lie group $S$ by a closed subgroup $R$ |
| $\mathfrak s = \mathfrak r \oplus \mathfrak k$ | reductive decomposition of the Lie algebra of $S$: $\mathfrak r$ of $R$, $\mathfrak k$ its complement |
| $\operatorname{Ad}_g$, $\operatorname{ad}_X$ | adjoint representations of the group and of the algebra |
| $T_a$ | anti-Hermitian generators, $[T_a, T_b] = f_{ab}{}^c\, T_c$ |
| $f_{ab}{}^c$ | real structure constants of a Lie algebra |
| $t_a = iT_a$ | Hermitian generators |
| $\sigma_a$ | Pauli matrices |
| $\lambda_A$ | Gell-Mann matrices |
| $L_a$ | basis of $\mathfrak{so}(3)$, $(L_a)_{bc} = -\epsilon_{abc}$ |
| $J_3$, $J_\pm$ | Hermitian angular-momentum combinations, $J_a = iT_a$ in a representation |
| $\mathfrak h$ | Cartan subalgebra |
| $\kappa(X, Y)$ | Killing form |
| $\mathfrak{gl}(n, \mathbb K)$, $\mathfrak{sl}(n, \mathbb K)$, $\mathfrak{sp}(2n)$, $\mathfrak z$ | all, traceless and symplectic matrices with the commutator; centre of a Lie algebra |
| $Sp(2n, \mathbb R)$, $\mathbf J$ | symplectic group $\{\mathbf M^\top\mathbf J\mathbf M = \mathbf J\}$, $\mathbf J = \begin{pmatrix} \mathbf 0 & \mathbf I_n \\ -\mathbf I_n & \mathbf 0 \end{pmatrix}$ |
| $\exp$, $d\phi$ | exponential map $X \mapsto e^X$; Lie algebra homomorphism induced by a Lie group homomorphism $\phi$ |
| $L_h$, $R_h$, $c_h$ | left translation $g \mapsto hg$, right translation $g \mapsto gh$, conjugation $g \mapsto hgh^{-1}$ |
| $X^A$, $\xi_a$ | left-invariant vector field $g \mapsto gA$; the frame $X^{T_a}$ of $SU(2)$ |
| $\theta = g^{-1}dg$, $\sigma^A$ | Maurer-Cartan form and its components, the left-invariant one-forms |
| $\mathbf R(t)$, $\mathbf n \cdot \mathbf L$ | rotation by $t$ about the third axis; $n_aL_a$, whose exponential $e^{t\,\mathbf n \cdot \mathbf L}$ is the rotation by $t$ about the unit vector $\mathbf n$ |
| $\mathcal J_a$, $K_a$ | rotation and boost generators of $\mathfrak{so}(1, 3)$ |
| $\boldsymbol\omega$, $\boldsymbol\Omega$ | angular velocity in the body, $\mathbf R^{-1}\dot{\mathbf R} = \boldsymbol\omega \cdot \mathbf L$, and in space, $\dot{\mathbf R}\mathbf R^{-1} = \boldsymbol\Omega \cdot \mathbf L$ |
| $\rho$ | representation, $\rho: G \to GL(V)$ |
| $\bar\rho$ | conjugate representation |
| $\chi(g)$ | character, $\chi(g) = \operatorname{tr}\rho(g)$ |
| $\chi_\rho$, $\mathcal C(G)$ | character of the representation $\rho$; the space of class functions on $G$ |
| $\langle\phi, \psi\rangle_G$ | inner product $\frac{1}{\lvert G\rvert}\sum_g\phi(g)^*\psi(g)$ of functions on a finite group |
| $\operatorname{Hom}_G(V, V')$ | intertwiners, linear maps $X$ with $X\rho(g) = \rho'(g)X$ |
| $\rho^*$, $m\rho$ | dual representation $\rho^*(g) = (\rho(g)^{-1})^\top$; direct sum of $m$ copies of $\rho$ |
| $\mathbb C[G]$, $\rho_{\mathrm{reg}}$ | space with basis $e_g$, $g \in G$; the regular representation $\rho_{\mathrm{reg}}(h)e_g = e_{hg}$ |
| $[\mathbf v]_\times$ | antisymmetric matrix of the cross product, $[\mathbf v]_\times\mathbf w = \mathbf v \times \mathbf w$ |
| $V_j$, $D^j(g)$ | spin-$j$ representation space and its matrices |
| $\mathfrak g_{\mathbb C}$, $\rho^*$, $\rho_1 \boxtimes \rho_2$ | complexification $\mathfrak g + i\mathfrak g$; dual $-\rho(X)^\top$ of a Lie algebra representation; $\rho_1(X_1) \otimes 1 + 1 \otimes \rho_2(X_2)$ on a direct sum $\mathfrak g_1 \oplus \mathfrak g_2$ |
| $V_\mu$, $m(\mu)$ | weight space of the weight $\mu$ and its multiplicity |
| $\alpha$, $\mathfrak g_\alpha$, $E_\alpha$, $\alpha_i$ | root, root space, root vector, simple roots |
| $\omega_1$, $\omega_2$, $(a, b)$ | fundamental weights of $\mathfrak{su}(3)$; the irreducible representation with highest weight $a\omega_1 + b\omega_2$ |
| $A_{ij}$, $s_\alpha$ | Cartan matrix $2(\alpha_i, \alpha_j)/(\alpha_j, \alpha_j)$; Weyl reflection in the root $\alpha$ |
| $\Omega_B(\rho)$, $C_2(\rho)$ | Casimir operator $\sum B^{ab}\rho(T_a)\rho(T_b)$ for an invariant form $B$; quadratic Casimir $-\sum_a\rho(T_a)^2$ of $\mathfrak{su}(N)$ |
| $T(\rho)$ | Dynkin index, $\operatorname{tr}(\rho(X)\rho(Y)) = 2T(\rho)\operatorname{tr}(XY)$ |
| $\rho^{\otimes k}$, $\mathbf m(I)$ | $k$-th tensor power of the defining representation of $\mathfrak{su}(N)$, $\sum_jX^{(j)}$ with $X$ in slot $j$; content of the word $I$, $m_i(I) = \lvert\{j : i_j = i\}\rvert$ |
| $\lvert\lambda\rvert$, $\mathbf w(\lambda)$, $a_i$ | number of boxes of a Young diagram; its $\mathfrak{su}(N)$ weight $\sum_i\lambda_i\mathbf e_i - \frac{\lvert\lambda\rvert}N\sum_i\mathbf e_i$; Dynkin labels $\lambda_i - \lambda_{i + 1}$ |
| $v_\lambda$, $V(\lambda)$, $\rho_\lambda$ | highest weight vector $\bigotimes_j(\mathbf e_1 \wedge \dots \wedge \mathbf e_{\lambda'_j})$ of a Young diagram; the irreducible representation it generates |
| $c(i, j)$, $d_N(\lambda)$ | content $j - i$ of a box; hook-content number $\prod(N + c(i, j))/h(i, j)$ |
| $P_{a, b}$, $H_{a, b}$, $\Delta_{xy}$ | polynomials of degree $a$ in $\mathbf x$ and $b$ in $\mathbf y$; those killed by $\Delta_{xy} = \sum_k\partial_{x_k}\partial_{y_k}$ |
| $W$ | Weyl group, generated by the Weyl reflections $s_\alpha$ |
| $\mathfrak{usp}(2n)$ | compact symplectic algebra, $\mathfrak u(2n) \cap \mathfrak{sp}(2n, \mathbb C)$ |
| $A_r$, $B_r$, $C_r$, $D_r$, $G_2$ | types of root systems and Dynkin diagrams ($D_r$ here is not the dihedral group $D_n$) |
| $\langle f\rangle$ | average of a continuous function over $SU(2)$ |
| $\mathbf E_{ij}$, $M_{ij}$ | matrix units; rotation generators $\mathbf E_{ij} - \mathbf E_{ji}$ of $\mathbb R^n$ |
| $\mathbf 1$, $\mathbf 3$, $\bar{\mathbf 3}$, $\mathbf 8$ | irreducible representations labelled by their dimension |
| $\operatorname{Hol}$ | holonomy group |
| $\operatorname{Cl}(p, q)$ | Clifford algebra with $p$ positive and $q$ negative generators |
| $\operatorname{Spin}(p, q)$ | spin group |

Conventions:

- Generators are anti-Hermitian with real structure constants, $[T_a, T_b] = f_{ab}{}^c\, T_c$, normalised in the
  fundamental representation of $SU(2)$ and $SU(3)$ by $\operatorname{tr}(T_aT_b) = -\tfrac12\delta_{ab}$. For
  $\mathfrak{su}(2)$, $T_a = -\tfrac{i}{2}\sigma_a$ and $f_{ab}{}^c = \epsilon_{abc}$; for $\mathfrak{su}(3)$,
  $T_A = -\tfrac{i}{2}\lambda_A$. The Hermitian generators of the physics literature are $t_a = iT_a$.
- The Clifford relation is $vw + wv = 2\eta(v, w)$, so $v^2 = +\eta(v, v)$.
- Cosets are written $S/R$ with $\mathfrak s = \mathfrak r \oplus \mathfrak k$; the letters $S$ and $R$ name groups
  only inside such a coset.
